use.flag: Enable full-featured services requiring extra backends (cryptography for TLS/encryption, pymysql for RDS MySQL, asyncssh for EC2 SSH emulation)

pkgmetadata.longdescription: Ministack is a free, open-source local AWS emulator and drop-in replacement for LocalStack. It emulates 55+ AWS services (S3, SQS, DynamoDB, Lambda, RDS, etc.) with real database backends, full Terraform compatibility, and no feature paywalls. Includes the ministack server and the awslocal CLI wrapper that redirects aws commands to the local endpoint.
